import numpy as np

def unit(v):
    v=np.array(v,float); n=np.linalg.norm(v)
    return v/n if n>1e-9 else v
def rot_align(a,b):
    a=unit(a); b=unit(b); v=np.cross(a,b); c=np.dot(a,b)
    if np.linalg.norm(v)<1e-9:
        if c>0: return np.eye(3)
        axis=unit(np.cross(a,[1,0,0]) if abs(a[0])<0.9 else np.cross(a,[0,1,0]))
        K=np.array([[0,-axis[2],axis[1]],[axis[2],0,-axis[0]],[-axis[1],axis[0],0]])
        return np.eye(3)+2*K@K
    K=np.array([[0,-v[2],v[1]],[v[2],0,-v[0]],[-v[1],v[0],0]])
    return np.eye(3)+K+K@K*(1/(1+c))
def rot_about(axis,ang):
    a=unit(axis); K=np.array([[0,-a[2],a[1]],[a[2],0,-a[0]],[-a[1],a[0],0]])
    return np.eye(3)+np.sin(ang)*K+(1-np.cos(ang))*(K@K)
def methyl_Hs(C,X,r=1.09):
    d=unit(np.array(C)-np.array(X))
    t=unit(np.cross(d,[0,0,1]) if abs(d[2])<0.9 else np.cross(d,[1,0,0])); b=np.cross(d,t)
    return [np.array(C)+r*(-1/3*d+(2*np.sqrt(2)/3)*(np.cos(a)*t+np.sin(a)*b)) for a in (0,2*np.pi/3,4*np.pi/3)]
def tetra_complete(d_fixed_list):

def tetra_two(d1,d2):
    m=unit(-(d1+d2)); tt=unit(np.cross(m,[0,0,1] if abs(m[2])<0.95 else [1,0,0])); bb=np.cross(m,tt)

        err=abs(np.dot(v,d1)+1/3)+abs(np.dot(v,d2)+1/3)+abs(np.dot(v,w)+1/3)
        if best is None or err<best[0]: best=(err,v,w)
